name: Palbociclib
mechanism: Selective inhibitor of cyclin D-CDK4/6 that prevents RB phosphorylation, inducing G1 arrest in ER-positive breast cancer cells, used with endocrine therapy.
monitoring: Blood counts before each cycle and early in treatment
interactions: Avoid strong CYP3A inhibitors and inducers.
resistance: RB1 loss, CCNE1 amplification/cyclin E-CDK2 activation, CDK6 amplification, FAT1 loss, PI3K-AKT activation and ESR1 mutations.
